title: Choice dialog
responsibility: Opens supplied choices beside their trigger in a keyboard-accessible modal, preserving panel headings and viewport bounds.

inputs.name: ChoiceDialog.label
inputs.description: Required accessible name for the trigger and dialog.

inputs.name: ChoiceDialog.title
inputs.description: Required tooltip on the opening button.

inputs.name: ChoiceDialog.disabled
inputs.description: Optional flag, false by default, disabling the trigger. Does not close an already-open dialog.

inputs.name: ChoiceDialog.activeCount
inputs.description: Optional count forwarded to the trigger data-active attribute. Defaults to JavaScript undefined, omitting the attribute.

inputs.name: ChoiceDialog.width
inputs.description: Required preferred width in pixels, capped at viewport width minus 24 pixels.

inputs.name: ChoiceDialog.maxHeight
inputs.description: Required maximum height in pixels, capped at dynamic viewport height minus 24 pixels; overflow scrolls.

inputs.name: ChoiceDialog.gap
inputs.description: Optional gap between dialog-grid children in pixels; defaults to 6.

inputs.name: ChoiceDialog.icon
inputs.description: Required content rendered inside the trigger button.

inputs.name: ChoiceDialog.onopen
inputs.description: Optional callback called after showing the dialog; returned work is not awaited. Defaults to JavaScript undefined, with no callback.

inputs.name: ChoiceDialog.children
inputs.description: Required content function receiving a close callback for dismissing the dialog after selection.

inputs.name: ChoiceDialog.footer
inputs.description: Optional sticky action-row snippet receiving the close callback. Defaults to JavaScript undefined, with no footer.

outputs.name: ChoiceDialog
outputs.description: Trigger and anchored modal, clamped to the viewport and clear of an enclosing panel header. Overflow scrolls. Opening focuses the selected enabled choice; Escape or backdrop click closes only this picker and returns focus to its trigger.

errors.name: Native dialog error
errors.description: The browser may reject showModal when the dialog cannot enter its modal state; the component does not suppress that exception.

errors.name: Caller snippet or callback error
errors.description: Errors from the icon, children, footer or onopen callback propagate; the component does not catch them.
